item.title: Iran deal presents political nightmare for Netanyahu
item.description: Donald Trump's ceasefire agreement with Iran leaves the Israeli PM trapped in a new political and security dilemma.

item.title: Unclear if US-Iran agreement will provide respite to Lebanon
item.description: Pakistan says the deal includes Lebanon, but recent ceasefires there have failed to take hold.

item.title: Bowen: Iran deal ends Trump's war that revealed limit of US dominance
item.description: The deal to end fighting and re-open the Strait of Hormuz leaves the sides where they were 24 hours before the war - only with thousands now dead.

item.title: טראמפ עשוי לפרסם את הסכם ארה"ב עם איראן לפני יום שישי, אומר ואנס
item.description: סגן נשיא ארה"ב אומר שההסכם הוא "בערך עמוד וחצי" ו"כללי מאוד", כלומר פרטים רבים יעובדו מאוחר יותר.
